entities.summary: English naturalist (1809-1882) whose On the Origin of Species (1859) presented the theory of evolution by natural selection, fundamentally transforming biology and humanity's understanding of its place in nature. His five-year voyage on HMS Beagle and decades of meticulous research produced one of science's most consequential theories.
